title: Binary Fourier coefficient
statement: For a real-valued function $f$ on the binary cube and a subset $S$ of its coordinates, the Fourier coefficient at $S$ is $\widehat f(S)=\mathbb E_x[f(x)\chi_S(x)]$, where $x$ is uniformly distributed on the binary cube and $\chi_S$ is the Walsh character indexed by $S$.
hypotheses_covered: A real-valued function $f$ on the binary cube
